name: open-zcode-game-plugins
description: Community-maintained catalog of game-development plugins for ZCode and KayingCode. Unofficial.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 社区维护的 ZCode / KayingCode 游戏开发方向开源插件目录，非官方产物。
description_i18n.en: Community-maintained catalog of game-development plugins for ZCode and KayingCode. Unofficial.

notice: Not an official ZCode project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Z.AI / Zhipu AI.

protocol.reason: KayingCode.localrun and local-first hosts reject remote marketplace / CDN plugin sources.
steps: Fetch this catalog.json over HTTPS (do not cache indefinitely).
Filter entries by hosts, category and keywords; read description_i18n for the user's language.
Resolve source.type: bundled (files inside this repo), git (clone at source.ref), or zip (download and verify sha256).
Place the host package directory at a stable local path; never write into the host's internal state directly.
Verify marketplace.json and the plugin manifest exist and that name/version match this entry; verify LICENSE / NOTICE are present.
Register the local directory as a local marketplace source (or add it to plugins.dirs), then install and enable the plugin.
Report what was installed, its version, and the exact local path to the user.
constraints: HTTPS only; prefer immutable commit SHAs over mutable tags.
Verify sha256 whenever source.type is zip; abort on mismatch.
Never register a remote GitHub URL as a marketplace source in local-first hosts.
Do not execute plugin install scripts, hooks, or downloaded binaries without user review.
Do not overwrite an existing installed plugin without a backup and explicit confirmation.
The plugin's own license applies, not this repository's Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: kaying-for-ui

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏界面设计UI设计-咖影

plugins.description: Game UI design and handoff workflow: from GDD/PRD and design specs to screen extension, component breakdown, sprite slicing, atlas packing, and Godot/Unity/Cocos JSON handoff.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏 UI 设计与交付全流程：从 GDD/PRD、风格契约、页面视觉到组件拆解、切图、图集打包与 Godot/Unity/Cocos 引擎 JSON 交付；零依赖 Node CLI，开箱即用。
description_i18n.en: Game UI design and handoff workflow: from GDD/PRD and design specs to screen extension, component breakdown, sprite slicing, atlas packing, and Godot/Unity/Cocos JSON handoff. Zero-dependency Node CLI.

examplePrompts: 用咖影根据参考图为一个国风卡牌 RPG 搭建完整 UI 项目：先完成策划与设计规格，再生成主界面视觉
把这张主界面拆成透明底组件，然后切雪碧图为单张 PNG 并打包图集
Generate 9-slice, atlas, and Unity/Godot handoff JSON

requires: node>=18 (bundled with the host; nothing to install)

notes_i18n.zh-CN: 将 bundled/kaying-for-ui/<宿主> 目录放到本机稳定路径，在宿主的「插件市场 → 新增」中注册为本地源后安装启用；不要注册远程 URL。
notes_i18n.en: Copy bundled/kaying-for-ui/<host> to a stable local path, register that directory as a local marketplace source in the host, then install and enable the plugin. Do not register a remote URL.
